title: #418 Trailer Out: The Last Warning
excerpt: Official trailer for #418: The Last Warning — out in Hindi, Tamil and Kannada.
body:
• The trailer for #418: The Last Warning dropped October 05, 2026.
  • Written and directed by Kirtan Nadagouda.
  • Out in Hindi, Tamil and Kannada — pick your language below.

The makers of #418: The Last Warning have released the official trailer, unveiled October 05, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to theaters — watch it below.
